_note: Version-matched Red Hat documentation used by the Upgrade workflow. A step that updates the cluster INTO minor X cites the minor-X documentation. docs.redhat.com refuses automated requests (HTTP 403), so these links could not be fetched by tooling: 'verification' records how each was established, and humanVerified stays false until a person opens it and records the date. Never cite 5.0 documentation for 4.20-4.22.
